Committee: County and Municipal Government
Sponsor: Whitt
Analyst: John Friedenreichk
Date: 03/01/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 406 as introduced could increase the obligations of any airport authority that enters into a contract to allow a car sharing program at the respective airport. These obligations could be offset by any fees imposed by the authority for the operation of such program.
Reed Ingram, Chair
County and Municipal Government
